description:
Hintio is a desktop AI assistant for authorized questions, meetings and learning. Choose screen and audio context, add resume text or custom instructions, and review contextual AI-generated responses in an adjustable overlay.

Import PDF or DOCX context, review session history and export records. Choose speaker, microphone, combined or no-audio modes. Stop capture and withdraw cloud consent from the live session or privacy controls. Only capture and share material you are authorized to use.

AI responses may be inaccurate. Review important answers before relying on them. Report response by email prepares a draft: review and redact it before sending.

Free installation; paid service access and a valid access token are required. Internet is required for cloud sessions. Intended India pricing is INR 2,049/month or INR 14,000/year. Live prices, renewal, cancellation and usage terms are pending verification; replace this draft wording before submission.

The Store build encrypts local records using AES-256-GCM with a Windows-protected key. Exports may be unencrypted. Cloud processing is subject to provider terms. Updates are managed by Microsoft Store. Screen-sharing behavior depends on the capture tool; invisibility is not guaranteed.
features: Selectable speaker, microphone, combined and no-audio session modes

capabilityJustifications.runFullTrust: Electron desktop app uses normal user-level desktop window, global shortcut, screen/audio capture and native module APIs. It does not request administrator elevation.
capabilityJustifications.microphone: Captures microphone audio only in a user-selected microphone-enabled session mode.
capabilityJustifications.internetClient: Validates access tokens, sends selected context to configured AI providers and downloads optional local models.
